target_definition: Predicting instantaneous average fish weight (g) from current visit environmental/water-quality features
available_sample_count: 5,569 observations (or 3,402 daily pond visits) across 265 ponds
missing_data_limitations: 55.2% missing in water_quality.csv; fish age/DOC missing
potential_leakage_risks: High risk of spurious correlation: static water quality does not determine cumulative fish age; same-pond repeated visits cause temporal leakage
verdict_rationale: Instantaneous water quality does not biologically determine somatic body mass. Fish weight reflects cumulative feeding and growth over months, not today's DO or pH.

candidate_target: B. Next-Visit Fish Weight (W_t+1) or Interval Weight Gain (Delta W)
target_definition: Predicting fish weight (W_t+1) or weight change (Delta W) at subsequent scheduled visit (t+1), conditioned on initial weight (W_t), interval (Delta t), feed, and water quality
available_sample_count: 2,497 consecutive revisit pairs (3 <= Delta t <= 45 days) across 240 unique ponds
missing_data_limitations: Missing stocking date/DOC; 5.77% negative weight jumps due to partial harvests/thinning; 34.28% zero delta due to coarse 50/100g rounding
ground_truth_exists: Yes (real measured consecutive weights at t and t+1)
time_based_prediction_evaluable: Yes (strict chronological split by visit date t; GroupKFold by pond_id)
potential_leakage_risks: Low if pairs strictly partitioned by cutoff date t and grouped by pond_id; baseline persistence (W_t+1 = W_t) must be benchmarked
verdict_rationale: Best scientifically defensible target. Solves absence of stocking dates by using W_t as dynamic initial condition. Grounded in aquaculture bioenergetics.

target_definition: Predicting total accumulated living fish mass harvested at end of culture cycle
missing_data_limitations: 100% missing: no harvest biomass, no harvest date, no stocking date, no final survival counts
potential_leakage_risks: Extreme: calculating synthetic biomass (Weight * Density * Area) creates circular ungrounded target
verdict_rationale: Harvested biomass was never measured. Synthesizing biomass violates strict scientific integrity guidelines and manufactures unverified labels.

candidate_target: D. End-of-Cycle Yield Estimation (kg/acre or tons/acre)
target_definition: Predicting total farm yield per unit area at commercial harvest completion
missing_data_limitations: 100% missing: no harvest dates, no cycle lengths, no harvest weight
potential_leakage_risks: Extreme: any derived yield would be pure simulation without ground truth
verdict_rationale: End-of-cycle agricultural yield ground truth does not exist. Predictive modeling cannot be evaluated or validated.
